correctness.rationale: For each agent row, own S~Gamma(r,1) and rival deletion residual Y=sum of smallest r-1 independent exponentials; agent rows are mutually independent, giving P_(n,r)=q^n. Exponential order spacings decompose Y into independent Exp((t+1)/t), t=1,..,r-1; hypoexponential partial fractions and gamma integration yield the exact multinomial rational q. The slowest tail C exp(-alpha s), alpha=r/(r-1), C=(r-1)^(r-1), with substitution z=C n exp(-alpha s) gives q~K_r n^(-(r-1)/r)(log n)^(r-1) by dominated convergence for fixed r; no relative asymptotic for P itself. For r=2 derived q_2,2=8/9, q_3,2=184/225 and EF baseline n^-n. Independently checked 18 finite rational cases; not a proof of asymptotics.
